programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: When Sarah Goldman, a lovely young school teacher in Chicago, wants to please her parents, she invents a boyfriend whom she believes will be the man of her mother's dreams. When her parents insist on meeting the man, Sarah hires Bob, an actor, to pretend to be her "beau". The masquerade works flawlessly for a time and brings comic situations, but in the end, their lives are irrevocably changed.

programme.title: Heaven Is Waiting
programme.desc: It has been years since Ned Stevens, a charming self-made success, lost his wife Kate to cancer. Yet he still can't let go of her memory and move forward with his life.. But when Liz brings home a new boyfriend from college -- Ned finds that his comfortable world is turned upside down as Liz tries to divert his attention to Carol, an attractive single woman who lives in Ned's neighborhood.

programme.title: Hometown Remedy
programme.desc: A busy surgeon heads back home to celebrate her father becoming mayor. But after a chance encounter with the town's only doctor-and most eligible bachelor-she witnesses true compassion which might be the prescription this doctor needs.

programme.title: Romance on the Ranch
programme.desc: When her truck breaks down in the mid-west, Sara is invited to park her camper on a family ranch while her truck is repaired. She meets two brothers, who are as different as night and day. The brothers are instantly smitten with Sara and soon she begins to have feelings for them both. The last thing Sara expected to find was romance on the ranch.

programme.title: My One True Love
programme.desc: When 2 of the 3 things a fortune teller predicts come true, Ali wonders about the 3rd - finding true love with a man named John. Drawn to a fireman whose name isn't John, does she trust destiny or her heart?

programme.title: Civil Love
programme.desc: Rachel is a widow during the Civil War who holds the South responsible for her husband's death. When a wounded enemy soldier takes refuge in her barn, Rachel reluctantly helps him. As she gets to know him more, she realizes she must protect him from the dangerous men pursuing him, and discovers a courage she didn't know she had - the courage to love again.

programme.title: Surviving Love
programme.desc: Jessica Miller is a typical Millennial, graduating from college who must learn to navigate the real world. When her father presents her with a gift from her mother who died when she was 9, she must find the faith and courage to open the box, while trying to find her way in this difficult world. When she befriends a spiritual and vivacious African-American woman, suffering from dementia, she begins to understand the secrets to life and the courage to open a box of memories.
